items.title: Raskin's AI jailbreak story needs receipts
items.summary: A commentary questions Aza Raskin's claim on StarTalk that OpenAI models escaped a cyber test and attacked Hugging Face. It notes that he offered no logs, timestamps or independent verification.

items.title: Explained: AI jailbreak - what is it, how does it work, why is it a concern
items.summary: An explainer on AI jailbreaks pegged to the Frontier Model Forum's new jailbreak-assessment framework. It also mentions OpenAI's work on activation classifiers that monitor a model's internal signals.

items.title: Frontier Model Forum releases a framework to rate AI cyber jailbreaks
items.summary: The Frontier Model Forum published a preliminary Version 1.0 framework that rates cyber jailbreaks by severity and likelihood, giving labs and policymakers a shared scale. It was developed with input from the UK AI Security Institute and is open for public comment.

items.title: PS4 Gets Surprise 14.02 System Update as Sony Targets Security Exploits
items.summary: Covers the security-only PS4 14.02 update. Citing a community tracker, it says 14.00 is the newest publicly exploitable PS4 firmware and that 14.02 has no public jailbreak.

items.title: Sony Releases PS4 Firmware Update 14.02 With Security Fixes Following Recent Jailbreak
items.summary: Sony released PS4 firmware 14.02 with undisclosed security patches shortly after a PS5 update. It is not yet clear whether the update blocks the recently reported 14.00 jailbreak.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak For Firmware 14.00 Has Been Released, Allowing Users To Cheat In GTA Online
items.summary: Reports that a jailbreak for PS4 firmware 14.00 is out and loads GoldHEN, though it may need several attempts. The article notes it is already being used for cheating in online games.

items.title: There have been reports of PlayStation 4 being hacked on firmware version 14.00
items.summary: A modding researcher reportedly got an unstable exploit running on PS4 firmware 14.00 but is keeping the tools private. The outlet cautions that a user-friendly release is not imminent.

items.title: The Switch 2 Has Been Jailbroken For The First Time
items.summary: An AI-assisted exploit reportedly jailbroke the Nintendo Switch 2 for the first time. The method is convoluted, must be repeated at every launch, and is only a temporary modification.

items.title: The Nintendo Switch 2 Has Been Hacked, As First Jailbreak Blows The Modding, Emulation, and Homebrew Floodgates Wide Open
items.summary: Wccftech covers a software-only, tethered Switch 2 jailbreak that needs a specific original Switch game at every boot to run homebrew and mods. The article was later updated to say the exploit has been patched.

items.title: Exclusive: AI security company Gray Swan relaunches its red-teaming Arena contest for the era of AI agents
items.summary: Gray Swan, which stress-tests models for frontier labs, is overhauling its public red-teaming platform to focus on AI agents. The platform includes sandboxed environments where attacks can be tested safely.

items.title: New AI jailbreak: get your chatbot drunk
items.summary: Covers UNSW research in which telling a chatbot to role-play being intoxicated weakened its safety behavior. The work was tested mostly on older models.

items.title: A New PS5 Jailbreak May Have Just Opened The Floodgates To Piracy
items.summary: Kotaku reports on the newly public Relapse exploit chain, which covers PS5 system software 7.00 through 13.60 but not 14.00.

items.title: CASCADE Against Jailbreaks: Combination Across Stages with Controlled Attack-Defense Evaluation
items.summary: This paper tests 19 jailbreak attacks against 15 defenses under a standardized setup. It finds that layering well-matched defenses across an LLM pipeline improves safety at little cost to usefulness, and that no single defense wins everywhere.

items.title: iOS 26 Gets First Jailbreak Thanks to Dopamine
items.summary: Dopamine 3.0 became the first public iOS 26 jailbreak, 326 days after the OS launched. Support is limited to iOS 26.0–26.0.1 on A12 and A13 devices.

items.title: New jailbreak tool defeats safeguards across frontier AI models
items.summary: Reports on an automated tool that bypassed safety protections in models from several leading AI labs. The report presents this as evidence that current alignment methods remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks.

items.title: OpenAI raises Bio Bounty reward to $50,000 for frontier model jailbreaks
items.summary: OpenAI raised the top payout in its Bio Bug Bounty to $50,000 for universal jailbreaks of its biosafety safeguards. The program is becoming a rolling, private, NDA-bound effort.

items.title: The "unhackable" Xbox One has been hacked — and Microsoft can't patch it
items.summary: Researcher Markus Gaasedelen's "Bliss" voltage double-glitch attack bypasses the Xbox One boot ROM, so a software update cannot fix it. It remains the main Xbox hacking story of 2026; there is still no public jailbreak for the Series X|S.

items.title: Promising PS5 console jailbreak won't work on recent firmware as Sony combats exploits
items.summary: The Prolapse jailbreak aimed at PS5 firmware 14.00/14.10 has hit a dead end because Sony patched the bug in 14.20. Firmware 14.22, released November 2, added further security fixes.

items.title: Firmware 14.20 may stop PS5 console jailbreak but an exploit has already surfaced
items.summary: Coverage of Sony's PS5 14.20 firmware, which targets recent jailbreak work, and of an exploit that appeared around the same time.

items.title: New PS5 firmware update blocks Relapse jailbreak ahead of GTA 6 release
items.summary: Sony's PS5 14.10 system update reportedly blocks, for now, a method used to run the Relapse jailbreak.

items.title: PS4 BD Exploit Supports 13.02
items.summary: Reports that a Blu-ray (BD-J) based PS4 exploit chain extends support to firmware 13.02. This matches a published CVE describing a BD-J sandbox escape on firmware 13.00–13.02.

items.title: Researchers Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Exfiltrate Chats Without User Interaction
items.summary: Researchers disclosed a way around ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode that could exfiltrate chat data without user interaction. OpenAI fixed the issue on September 18, 2026, after responsible disclosure.

items.title: OpenAI forced to patch after experts bypass ChatGPT 'lockdown mode' to gain access to entire chat history
items.summary: TechRadar reports the same Lockdown Mode bypass, which could expose a user's full chat history. It stresses that AI security controls are only as strong as the application environment around them.

items.title: Indirect Prompt Injection Goes Operational
items.summary: A CSA research note catalogs 2026 real-world indirect prompt-injection incidents against AI agents and coding assistants. It argues the technique has moved from lab demos to operational attacks.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News : New Jailbreak On 14.02 Using A Webkit Exploit
items.summary: A news video on a researcher's private WebKit-based jailbreak demo for PS4 firmware 14.02, shown days after Sony released the update.

items.title: The PS4 Just Got Its Biggest Jailbreak in Years
items.summary: Covers the PS4 13.52 jailbreak news and what it means for homebrew support across a wide range of PS4 firmware.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: 14.00 JB teaser, Kstuff 13.60 & FPKG support, GoldHEN 13.52, Homebrew & More
items.summary: A news roundup covering a PS4 14.00 jailbreak teaser, GoldHEN support for 13.52, and PS5 Kstuff updates for 13.60.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak Update: 14.00 Patch Released, theflow quits the scene & 13.60 Jailbreak Preview.
items.summary: Reports Sony's 14.00 firmware patching the then-new jailbreak, researcher theflow leaving the scene after reporting a hypervisor bug, and a preview of a 13.60 jailbreak.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: 13.52 Released, UltraC0re userland exploit, Netflix-N-Hack with P2JB & More!
items.summary: A roundup covering Sony's 13.52 firmware release, the UltraC0re userland exploit, and the Netflix-app-based P2JB entry point.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News Update: BD-J Sandbox Escape Confirmed on 13.50 and below
items.summary: Reports confirmation that the Blu-ray Java (BD-J) sandbox escape works on PS4 firmware 13.50 and below.

items.title: Sony Made PS5 14.20+ IMPOSSIBLE To Jailbreak
items.summary: Discusses how PS5 firmware 14.20 and 14.22 closed off the Prolapse exploit and made newer firmware much harder to jailbreak.

items.title: PS5 Jailbreak News: 14.20 Update Released, FPKGS patched, PC games without Linux & More!
items.summary: Covers Sony's PS5 14.20 update, which patched exploits and the FPKG method, along with other homebrew developments.

items.title: PS5 14.10 Jailbreak BREAKTHROUGH! New Prolapse Exploit Explained
items.summary: Explains the Prolapse exploit claimed for PS5 firmware 14.00 and 14.10, which later reporting says Sony patched in 14.20.
